query:
SELECT AVG(day_avg)::float8 AS avg_viewers
        FROM (
            SELECT DATE(started_at) AS d, AVG(avg_viewers) AS day_avg
            FROM twitch_stream_sessions
            WHERE streamer_login = $1
              AND started_at >= $2
              AND duration_seconds > 300
            GROUP BY d
            HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
        ) sub
